summary: Strict checker clean. Last round's faults fixed: T2 is an open U, so T-L1 passes; Vantage placed 7 T2 stops and moved Skyport, and its answers match the stops. Timetable values are plausible and its time-only price fits the GDD travel rule. Open, not faults: the flat T1×T2 crossing at (0,-726) has no standard (Keel/Splice); Pulse did not act on the advisory ask to stagger timetables there; the T2 'shorter way round' question is out of date now it is not a ring; the 1.4 m/s walk pace is an assumption for Motive; Datum reports a stale-source conflict in notes›why for Aster.
